inputSpec.name: genome_lib
inputSpec.label: CTAT genome library
inputSpec.help: A CTAT genome library, which is a reference file bundle required by Trinity CTAT tools. This contains the genome indices and reference genome that are needed to run CTAT-Splicing.

inputSpec.name: cancer_splicing_index
inputSpec.label: Cancer splicing index
inputSpec.help: An index file for the ~24k introns that are enriched for splicing in tumor tissues as compared to normal tissues. It is required to run CTAT-Splicing.

inputSpec.name: refGene
inputSpec.label: refGene
inputSpec.help: The refGene.bam required to run CTAT-Splicing

inputSpec.name: refGene_sort
inputSpec.label: refGene sorted
inputSpec.help: The refGene.sort.bed.gz required to run CTAT-Splicing

inputSpec.name: refGene_sort_tbi
inputSpec.label: refGene sorted tbi
inputSpec.help: The refGene.sort.bed.gz.tbi required to run CTAT-Splicing

inputSpec.name: splice_junction
inputSpec.label: Splice Junction file
inputSpec.help: SJ.out.tab file identifing introns and reported by STAR/eggd_staraligner. Input file required.

inputSpec.name: chimeric_junction
inputSpec.help: Chimeric read alignments reported by STAR/eggd_staraligner. Input file required.

inputSpec.name: bam
inputSpec.label: bam
inputSpec.help: RNA-Seq BAM file from STAR/eggd_staraligner. Required for visualization, ideally coordinate-sorted or will be coordinate-sorted as part of the CTAT-Splicing run.

inputSpec.name: bam_index
inputSpec.label: bam_index
inputSpec.help: RNA-Seq BAM Index file from STAR/eggd_staraligner.

outputSpec.name: cancer_introns
outputSpec.label: cancer_introns
outputSpec.help: List of candidate cancer introns found in the tested sample.

outputSpec.name: introns
outputSpec.label: introns
outputSpec.help: List of all introns found in the tested sample. Introns as reported by STAR and annotated according to genes containing corresponding splice junctions.

outputSpec.name: html_igv_introns
outputSpec.label: html_igv_introns
outputSpec.help: Self-contained interactive IGV-report in html format based on the *.cancer.introns report.

outputSpec.name: ctatsplicing_chckpts
outputSpec.label: ctatsplicing_chckpts
outputSpec.help: CTAT-Splicing checkpoints folder tracking tests for each sub-task
